items.title: JDS – a Copilot skill suite for structuring AI coding behavior
items.raw_excerpt: A few months ago I stumbled on obra's superpowers repository https://github.com/obra/superpowers . I really liked the approach and idea that you enforce discipline for your agent through a skill-based workflow. Even though coding agents (copilot included) have become a lot better at natively handling complex tasks, they still wander off and lose track of things. I really liked how superpowers fixed this and how it enabled long-running sessions without the agent losing its "focus". So I decided to build a Copilot tailored skill suite around the core idea of superpowers. I didn't just want to port superpowers to Copilot, I took inspiration from it and improved on it. items.title: AI is making me dumb

title_i18n.en: AI is making me dumb
title_i18n.zh: 人工智能正在让我变笨。
title_i18n.es: La IA me está volviendo tonto.

excerpt_i18n.en: The article discusses how over-reliance on AI tools may impair critical thinking and problem-solving skills, making users 'dumber' despite efficiency gains.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 文章探讨了AI工具对个人认知能力的潜在负面影响，作者认为过度依赖AI可能导致批判性思维和问题解决能力的下降。尽管AI提高了效率，但用户可能因此变得“懒惰”，不再深入思考。

items.title: You Don't Align an AI, You Align with It
items.raw_excerpt: The article discusses a philosophical shift in AI alignment, arguing that instead of forcing AI to align with humans, humans should adapt and align themselves with AI for better collaboration. True alignment is bidirectional, requiring humans to understand AI behavior and coexist harmoniously.

title_i18n.en: You Don't Align an AI, You Align with It
title_i18n.zh: 你无法对齐AI，而是与AI对齐。
title_i18n.es: No alineas una IA, te alineas con ella.

excerpt_i18n.en: The article discusses a philosophical shift in AI alignment, arguing that instead of forcing AI to align with humans, humans should adapt and align themselves with AI for better collaboration. True alignment is bidirectional, requiring humans to understand AI behavior and coexist harmoniously.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 文章探讨了AI对齐的哲学转变，认为与其试图强制对齐AI，不如人类主动适应和调整自身以与AI协作。作者提出，真正的对齐是双向的，需要人类理解AI的行为模式并与之和谐共处。
